record.question: The screening test for syphilis is:
record.explanation: Answer D: VDRL. VDRL is a nontreponemal lipoidal-antigen test used in syphilis serologic algorithms. It is not sufficient alone to diagnose syphilis; results are interpreted with a treponemal test and clinical context. Reference: https://www.cdc.gov/mmwr/volumes/73/rr/rr7301a1.htm; https://www.cdc.gov/std/treatment-guidelines/syphilis.htm. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
